raw_translation: > Ito ay isang lokal na pagsasanay laro na walang tunay na pera, mga pagbili o poker diskarte payo. Ito ay gumagamit ng mga nakapirming mga blinds at pinasimple isang-action pusta rounds; bots ay pangunahing at maaasahan. source: This is a local practice game with no real money, purchases or poker strategy advice. It uses fixed blinds and simplified one-action betting rounds; bots are basic and predictable. Your chips and hand stay in this page session and reset when you leave or reset the tool.
